[Upstream report and reproducer](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/30980#issuecomment-6571123990). The PR-scoped local hooks passed; the full upstream check has not passed. Rebase after the main repair lands.

[Rebase validation and CI request](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47278#issuecomment-6571090752).
<!-- REBASE-48K-20261102:END -->

## Motivation

GLM-5.2 with DP attention runs the triton sparse-MLA decode with all 64 heads on each rank, an fp8 KV cache, and topk 2048. MTP adds 6 verify rows per request. At 48 to 96 rows, `triton_sparse_mla_fwd` uses a geometry that needs several rounds of CUs (BLOCK_H=16, four head blocks per row) and re-reads each row's gathered KV once per head block.

This PR adds a decode plan for that shape:
- **Speed.** The kernel is 2.4x to 3.2x faster at 48 to 96 rows.
- **Accuracy.** It is within fp8 tolerance of an fp32 reference: 37 to 38 dB SNR, against 26 to 37 dB on main.
- **End to end.** GLM-5.2 with DP attention (TP8 DP8, MTP) gets 11.8% lower median ITL.

Every other shape keeps main's path.

## Modifications

- **Decode plan** (`_decode_splitk_splits`).
  - Applies on gfx950 with an fp8 cache, a head count that is a multiple of 32, d_v 512 and tail 64.
  - Runs one head block per row (`BLOCK_H == H`), so each gathered KV row is read once.
  - Parallelism comes from KV splits, sized as `num_cu // rows`, so the grid stays within one round of CUs.
  - Applies when at least 2 splits fit, i.e. up to `num_cu / 2` rows (128 on MI355X).
- **Split-K partial loop.** Shape specialisations that only the decode plan turns on, so every existing caller keeps its compile-cache key:
  - i32 page offsets;
  - dense tiles;
  - 256-wide value groups at a two-deep pipeline;
  - in-place accumulator rescale;
  - streaming (`.cs`) KV loads;
  - P@V dots fenced out of the attention-chain layout;
  - a head-interleaved partial layout with its own reduce (`_sparse_mla_reduce_dq_kernel`);
  - write-through partial stores;
  - a compile-time tile trip count.
- **Residency-aware geometry** (`_decode_geometry`). Launches that exceed one round at BLOCK_H=16 but are not covered by the decode plan get a residency-aware `(BLOCK_H, PIPE_STAGES)`, on an fp8 cache with a multiple of 32 heads.
- **Fused-kernel async-copy scope.** The fused kernel at PIPE_STAGES=3 compiles without direct-to-LDS async copies on an fp8 cache (measured faster). bf16 keeps its current lowering.
- **DCP split-K path (#44322) is unchanged.**
  - The reduce kernel's LSE store is kept in both of its head-block branches.
  - A static assert rules out combining the compile-time trip count with a per-row `topk_length`.
- **Test.** `test_gfx950_fp8_64h_decode_plan_matches_reference` checks 48, 60 and 96 rows, with and without a -1 tail, against an fp32 reference at more than 35 dB.

## Accuracy Tests

`triton_sparse_mla_fwd` against an fp32 softmax reference over the selected tokens, SNR in dB:

| rows | 64 heads, fp8 | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| 48 | full index rows | 27.4 | 38.0 |
| 60 | full index rows | 25.8 | 37.7 |
| 72 / 84 / 96 | full index rows | 36.5 | 37.4 / 37.4 / 37.0 |
| 48 | -1 tail | 35.7 | 35.7 |
| 144 / 288 / 512 | full index rows | 36.6 | 36.6 (same path, bit-identical) |
| 16 heads (6 / 48 / 96 rows), bf16 cache | | | bit-identical to main |

The new test fails on main at 48 and 60 rows (25.9 and 27.2 dB). It passes on this branch, as does the rest of `test_triton_sparse_mla_hip.py` (22/22).

End to end:
- Setup: GLM-5.2-MXFP4, TP8 DP8 with DP attention, MTP with acceptance not simulated.
- `sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k`, 400 questions, 3 fresh servers per arm, alternating:

| | gsm8k |
|---|---|
| main | 0.950 / 0.935 / 0.940 (mean 0.942) |
| this PR | 0.932 / 0.948 / 0.943 (mean 0.941) |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

**Kernel**, `triton_sparse_mla_fwd`:
- 64 heads, fp8 cache, topk 2048, random indices into a 2.2M-token pool;
- one CUDA graph over 8 KV pools; us per call, median.

| rows | main | this PR | speedup |
|---|---|---|---|
| 48 | 90.2 | 28.6 | 3.15x |
| 60 | 90.2 | 31.9 | 2.83x |
| 72 | 113.1 | 37.1 | 3.05x |
| 84 | 112.9 | 38.7 | 2.92x |
| 96 | 113.4 | 47.6 | 2.38x |
| 144 / 288 / 512 | 113.3 / 230.9 / 241.4 | 113.3 / 230.7 / 240.5 | 1.00x |
| 16 heads: 6 / 48 / 96 | 11.8 / 28.0 / 37.6 | 12.0 / 27.0 / 37.2 | 0.99 / 1.04 / 1.01x |
| bf16 cache, 48 | 157.3 | 154.3 | 1.02x |

**End to end.**
- Setup: GLM-5.2-MXFP4, TP8 DP8 with DP attention, MTP (EAGLE 5 / 1 / 6), simulated acceptance 3.61, `--max-running-requests 64`.
- Benchmark: `bench_serving`, random 32k input / 1k output, concurrency 64, 128 prompts, 2 runs per server.
- Main and this PR alternate on one node.

| | median ITL ms | mean TPOT ms |
|---|---|---|
| main (3 servers) | 9.97 - 10.00 | 32.7 - 33.0 |
| this PR (4 servers) | 8.80 - 8.84 | 30.9 - 31.7 |

## How to reproduce

Hardware: MI355X (gfx950), ROCm 7.2. Kernel tests run on main's tree. End-to-end runs use `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261018` with main's `triton_sparse_mla.py` and `triton_sparse_mla_decode.py` copied in for the main arm, and this branch's `triton_sparse_mla.py` for the PR arm.
```bash
python3 -m pytest -q test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/test_triton_sparse_mla_hip.py
SGLANG_OPT_USE_TOPK_V2=true SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.61 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_METHOD=match-expected \
SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_TOKEN_MODE=real-draft-token python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 \
  --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --dsa-prefill-backend triton --dsa-decode-backend triton \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 5 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6 --tensor-parallel-size 8 --data-parallel-size 8 --enable-dp-attention \
  --max-running-requests 64 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 8
python3 -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-input-len 32000 \
  --random-output-len 1000 --random-range-ratio 1.0 --num-prompts 128 --max-concurrency 64 --seed 1
```

@@ -92,6 +92,25 @@ def _async_copy_is_harmful() -> bool:
     return hip is not None and hip.gcn_arch in _ASYNC_COPY_OFF_ARCHES
 
 
+def _no_async_copy_scope_is_effective() -> bool:
+    """Whether launches inside :func:`_no_async_copy` lower without async copies.
+
+    False when an explicit TRITON_HIP_USE_ASYNC_COPY=1 overrides the scope, or
+    when this Triton exposes no knob to check (be conservative).
+    """
+    try:
+        from triton import knobs
+    except ImportError:
+        return False
+
+    amd_knobs = getattr(knobs, "amd", None)
+    if not hasattr(amd_knobs, "use_async_copy"):
+        return False
+    if amd_knobs.use_async_copy is not None:
+        return not amd_knobs.use_async_copy
+    return _async_copy_is_harmful()
+
+
 @contextlib.contextmanager
 def _no_async_copy():
     """Compile enclosed DSA launches without direct-to-LDS async copies.
@@ -238,6 +257,75 @@ def _gfx950_sparse_mla_kv_splits(
     return kv_splits
 
 
+def _is_gfx950_decode_fp8_64h(
+    kv_dtype: torch.dtype,
+    H: int,
+    d_v: int,
+    d_tail: int,
+    kv_dim: int,
+) -> bool:
+    """Gate for the gfx950 FP8 decode shapes with a wide head count.
+
+    Distinct from :func:`_is_gfx950_sparse_mla_fp8` (which covers the TP4/TP8
+    prefill shapes with H in (8, 16)); this one guards the residency-aware
+    geometry table used for GLM-5.2 decode, where H is a multiple of 32.
+    """
+    return (
+        kv_dtype != torch.bfloat16
+        and H % 32 == 0
+        and H >= 32
+        and d_v == 512
+        and d_tail == 64
+        and kv_dim == 576
+        and is_gfx95_supported()
+    )
+
